remote_access: Tracked repository files and packed sky atlas; ignored native sky archives, raw CM1 snapshots, coastal wave histories and several spectral input files were absent from the remote workspace.
local_access: Verified local input copies and research-drive links in the isolated study/optical-comfort checkout.

moon_no_ozone_atlas.npz.evidence: Existing unfiltered exponential-profile sky solution; array-level comparison with the packed archive is recorded by local_sky.py.

earth_atlas.npz.evidence: Existing unfiltered exponential-profile sky solution; array-level comparison with the packed archive is recorded by local_sky.py.

moon_atlas.npz.evidence: Existing unfiltered exponential-profile sky solution; array-level comparison with the packed archive is recorded by local_sky.py.

coastal_wave_history.evidence: Existing nonstationary nested SWAN coastal history on research/lunar-seas. Local spectral files are checked against its output hashes.

cloud_inputs.admission: cloud_columns.py checks the CM1 build source and reconstructs dry density against saved domain diagnostics. Each consumed scalar and diagnostic snapshot is hashed in the exported source manifest.

storage: Bulk inputs, Python environment and generated histories live on the research drive; ignored checkout paths link to that storage.
